why: d4f66bbc batch-2 and batch-4 failed because a streamer was attached. OpenVINO pipeline_impl.cpp:530 allows streaming only at batch size 1 for greedy or multinomial decoding. v2 times the whole generate when there is more than one prompt and divides generated tokens by wall. It also measures the warm time-to-action P1's budget uses.

warm_probe.delta_derivation: 532 consecutive local-turn n_ctx gaps on d482c621 slo_escalate have median 182.5. The probe uses 183, the nearest integer.
warm_probe.tta: wall of the second turn, the 183-token delta plus the 64-token decode, on the cached prefix

warm_gpu_tta_s.derivation: Warm prefill is the d482c621 later-turn ttft median in the n_ctx band: 0.280774597 s for 3500-4500 (n=171) and 0.475439224 s for 5500-6500 (n=12). Decode of the remaining 63 tokens uses the d4f66bbc batch-1 median, 25.03689962110825 tok/s at 4000 and 27.792270687187713 tok/s at 6000. TTA is that prefill plus 63/decode.

warm_cpu_tta_s.derivation: No sealed CPU warm turn exists. The new-token prefill uses the 7f232f86 slope from n=1125 to n=2000, (23.151441406 - 14.048253906) / 875 = 0.010403642857142858 s/token, times 183. Decode of the remaining 63 tokens uses the d4f66bbc CPU batch-1 median, 10.803377382704173 tok/s at 4000 and 9.32269427462713 tok/s at 6000. Both predictions are under 10 s. The cold CPU prefill is not.

gpu_batch4_aggregate_over_batch1.metric: generated tokens divided by the wall of the whole generate, same definition on both sides
gpu_batch4_aggregate_over_batch1.cpu: SKIPPED_OVER_BUDGET when the projected wall exceeds 30 s, so this bar is GPU only
gpu_batch4_aggregate_over_batch1.derivation: The original bar stands. The clock changes because a streamer is illegal above batch size 1. 2608.19147 is still cited and is still not this prediction.

cpu_skip.projection_formula: From d4f66bbc batch-1 medians. batch-k wall = prefill + k * (wall - prefill). thinking uses the batch-1 wall.

boot.q_tier_clean: not appended. The prereg exists and there is no rehearsed launcher.
boot.formula: Serial upper bound of the probes v2 actually runs. GPU, both contexts, three repeats: batch-1 measured wall, batch-2 and batch-4 as prefill + k * (wall - prefill), thinking, retry, and greedy_tta measured walls, warm as turn-1 prefill plus one token plus the warm TTA prediction. CPU, both contexts, three repeats: batch-1, retry, greedy_tta, and warm (batch-1 wall plus the warm TTA prediction). batch-2, batch-4, and thinking on CPU are the skipped projections and are not in the sum. Plus 12 * 5.211120400010259 s from the 24634b40 model load. Plus canary overhead 752.1359013 s. Next whole second is 3159.
